summary: Verified the roulette wheel number-position fix on /games/roulette/hindi-roulette. Numbers now render at radius 122 from the wheel center (all 37 labels exactly at dist=122.00 in a 320x320 viewBox with R=140), i.e. ~87% of the way toward the outer wooden rim — matching the intended labelR = R - 18 = 122. Visually confirmed via screenshot during the 'PLACE BETS' phase that all 37 numbers (0-36) sit close to the outer wooden ring. All regressions passed: 37 segments with correct green/red/black coloring, bold white text with drop shadow (font 13-14px), history strip renders recent winners, bet placement + spin + result popup all functional (balance 6080 -> 6030 after ₹50 RED bet, result popup showed winning number '2'), ball lands under the 12 o'clock pointer, and no wheel shake/jitter (SVG bounding rect stable across time samples).
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is minimal and correct — only labelR changed from (R+RIN)/2=97.5 to R-18=122 in RouletteWheel.jsx line 91. No side effects observed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RouletteWheel SVG uses viewBox 0 0 320 320, center (160,160), R=140, RIN=55. Labels are at labelR=122 (all 37 confirmed programmatically). Round timing: 20s bet / ~10s spin / short result. Result popup appears as [role=dialog] type overlay. History strip data-testid was not required — the strip shows recent numbers in a horizontal row after the 'PLACE BETS' timer.
rca of the issue: Original code positioned wheel numbers at labelR=(R+RIN)/2=97.5 which is near the midpoint between hub (RIN=55) and outer rim (R=140), making numbers appear close to the center. Fix (line 91) changes labelR to R-18=122, placing numbers ~87% of the way toward the outer wooden rim — verified working.
